# `•c` — Case conversion

`•c Y` folds case.

```bpl
•c "AbC"           ⍝ "abc"
```

`1•c Y` uppercases; `¯1•c Y` lowercases.

```bpl
1•c "AbC"          ⍝ "ABC"
¯1•c "AbC"         ⍝ "abc"
```

Case conversion uses Unicode's simple case mappings. `•c` keeps the argument's shape and nesting, and leaves items that aren't characters unchanged.
